question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

(NOTE: The odd one out is not based on the number of vowels or consonants in the word)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/402c4354bd1de169b82ffbdbb48d6dc941d3dd9eae2607a7680173ae419f32c4.png] 

Option 2) IJOT

Option 3) FEKS
